The harness runs at ~1.22-2.98% of the advertised XDNA2 int8 ceiling (generic, no bespoke kernel). The clean iGPU forward win over the CPU is fp32 and SIZE-GATED (here 3.954x at b1·s256).

stages.honesty: This is the ONLY proof that actually ships — EZKL Halo2/KZG over BN254, CPU-ONLY on AMD. The Strix Halo win is 32 threads + 94 GB unified memory pushing the proof from a single head (logrows 16, ~2.9 GB) to the full 12-head MHA (logrows 21, ~82 GB) before the full transformer layer caps at the 94 GB ceiling. The iGPU/NPU NEVER touch this proof.

stages.name: Proof MSM offload — RDNA iGPU OpenCL Groth16 (RE-CAST)
stages.proof_system: bellperson Groth16 over BLS12-381 (RE-CAST of the attention matmuls Q,K,V/S=Q·Kᵀ/Y=A·V; softmax excluded as a lookup job)
stages.role: demonstrates the iGPU CAN accelerate a proof's MSM — but a different prover/curve than the shipping Stage-2 EZKL proof
durable_claims: GPU proof is bit-for-bit equal to the CPU proof (verify_ok=true; every offloaded MSM/NTT primitive is recomputed on the CPU and asserted GPU==CPU before timing) — a CORRECTNESS result, independent of any speed verdict.

The iGPU FFT/NTT primitive is the only place the iGPU plausibly helps a KZG/Groth16 prover at all (matching-size attribution proxy; ~2.6-5.2x solo on gpu-primitive.csv) — and even that needs a solo-guarded number to be quoted as a speed win.

headline_number.note: NOT a solo-verified number: the end-to-end prove_speedup is the SAME contention-prone metric the Demo C integrity track REFUTED (docs/INTEGRITY-REPORT.md — the published 1.34x/1.64x iGPU folding headline was REFUTED on a fair solo baseline; its 2026-06-16 replacement 0.70x/0.74x was itself published as a LOWER BOUND, and the 2026-08-29 PAIRED re-bench narrowed the OpenCL G1-only arm to 0.994x = PARITY, while gpu-wide 0.74x was NEVER re-measured and stays a floor), so this iGPU re-cast prove_speedup is likely contention-inflated too and is NOT claimed as an end-to-end iGPU proof win. The durable, contention-proof claims are bit-for-bit GPU==CPU correctness and the iGPU NTT primitive (attribution proxy).

fft_attribution.proxy: BN254 Fr NTT at log_n=ceil_log2(m) (matching-size attribution proxy, same basis as the bn254 MSM column) — NOT the BLS12-381 prover's internal FFT
fft_attribution.note: the iGPU FFT/NTT (~2.6-5.2x solo) outpaces the iGPU MSM by a wide margin: the clean-solo BN254 G1 MSM is 0.654-1.091x (below parity until ~2^22; the old ~1.1-1.35x solo figure was contention-inflated and is retired), so the NTT -- not the MSM -- is where the iGPU helps the proof most. The live end-to-end win is the prove_speedup column.

stages.honesty: This is a RE-CAST, not the shipping proof: EZKL itself CANNOT dispatch to the iGPU (it wires only CUDA/icicle + Apple Metal — blocker EZKL-GPU-BLOCKED-ON-AMD), so to put the iGPU on a proof at all the attention matmuls are re-cast into a bellperson Groth16 circuit over BLS12-381 (DIFFERENT prover and DIFFERENT curve from the Stage-2 Halo2/BN254 proof; softmax is excluded as a lookup job). The circuit is now MULTI-HEAD (a real 12-head MiniLM layer, one CRS). INTEGRITY RECONCILE (docs/INTEGRITY-REPORT.md): the end-to-end prove_speedup (1.120x -> 1.441x) is the SAME contention-prone metric the integrity track REFUTED for Demo C — there the published 1.34x/1.64x iGPU folding headline was REFUTED once the CPU baseline was measured on a fair, contention-guarded solo window; the 2026-06-16 replacement (0.70x/0.74x) was self-labelled a LOWER BOUND, and the 2026-08-29 PAIRED re-bench (interleaved arms, n=3 each, both arms check-off) lands the OpenCL G1-only arm at 0.994x = PARITY (never 'a win', never '0.6% slower'), with gpu-wide's 0.74x NEVER re-measured and therefore a floor. Parity is not acceleration. This re-cast prove runs on the same shared-LPDDR5X iGPU, was NOT taken under the solo guard (solo_verified=false), and is therefore likely inflated the same way; it is NOT claimed as an end-to-end iGPU proof speed win. The DURABLE, contention-proof claims are: (a) the GPU proof is bit-for-bit equal to the CPU proof (verify_ok=true; every offloaded MSM/NTT primitive is recomputed on the CPU and asserted GPU==CPU before timing) — a correctness result; and (b) the iGPU FFT/NTT primitive is the only place the iGPU plausibly helps a KZG/Groth16 prover (matching-size attribution proxy, ~2.6-5.2x solo) — and even that needs a solo-guarded number to quote as a speed win. The iGPU never touches EZKL Halo2.
